operations.description: Compute the linear parameter v2 = this[7] * a2 + this[8], blending the input a2 against field values.
Branch on v2 >= 1.0: the interpolated branch is taken only above the 1.0 threshold.
When v2 >= 1.0, compute inverse-blend attenuation (1.0 / v2 + (1.0 / v2^3 - 1.0 / v2) * this[9]) scaled by base value this[16] and return it.
When v2 < 1.0, return this[16] (base scale) unchanged.
